column3: Close to the Hebrew; כִּנִּים (“gnats”) is rendered “lice.”
Close to the Hebrew; the two locust words are rendered “locusts… Young locusts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “none who stumbled” is rendered “none feeble.”
Close to the Hebrew; the singular “he asked” is rendered “The people asked.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his holy word” is rendered “His holy promise.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם (“lands of the nations”) is rendered “the lands of the Gentiles.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!”
